task: Perform a fresh, strictly read-only independent validation review of BioFabric STEP-02 commit 72ca8d568b35a76aaa22f20de87075df50b7fdc7. Do not edit, stage, commit, delete, or create source/test/manifests/workflow artifacts; do not invoke Docker, a verifier, or Git. Inspect the interchange implementation and nearby model/session/layout/display/error contracts, focusing on crates/core/src/io/xml.rs and gw.rs and regression risk across align.rs, annotation.rs, attribute.rs, factory.rs, json.rs, order.rs, and sif.rs. The contract is lossless deterministic parse/write round trips wherever a format represents model state; malformed input must yield ParseError rather than silently losing data; standard BIF annotations, drain zones, metadata, scores, raw plugin payloads, full public DisplayOptions, and named NetworkLayout state remain compatible; XML modeled elements are structurally legal inside exactly one BioFabric root; and GW records are fully consumed. Thoroughly examine the final corrections: raw first-column-only GW comments with physical diagnostic lines; color-container parent/context enforcement; opaque plugInDataSets multiline XML comment and CDATA boundaries; XML scalar and attribute whitespace escaping/validation; declaration location and singleton enforcement. Assess practical compatibility with standard BIF hierarchy, external valid linkGroups, non-ASCII XML, XML comments/processing declarations, and legitimate GW grammar variants. ROOT's pinned bridge rustfmt check passed and cargo test -p biofabric-core --lib yielded 45 passed, with only the three known deferred alignment todo! stubs failing (cycle relation names, position codes, and position map); do not treat those named stubs as STEP-02 defects. Produce truthful RESULT.json whose summary begins exactly REVIEW: SHIP, REVIEW: REVISE, or REVIEW: BLOCK and whose evidence contains all exact headings Findings:, Contract coverage:, Questions:, and Verification gaps:. Every confirmed material finding must include file:line, consequence, and the smallest useful correction; keep questions/optional improvements separate. ROOT will decide acceptance only after reading your report.
acceptance_criteria: The review is independent and strictly read-only.
The report evaluates the whole stated interchange contract and the final XML/GW compatibility corrections.
RESULT.json has the required REVIEW decision and four headings with file/line evidence for material findings.
deliverables: A truthful detailed independent STEP-02 interoperability review in RESULT.json.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: The completed XML/GW compatibility patch passed its pinned source checks and needs one final independent review before acceptance.
